mainEntity.name: How long does a repaired wood fence typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a repaired wood fence depends heavily on the extent of the original damage, the quality of the repair materials, and ongoing maintenance. A well-executed repair using suitable materials can significantly extend your fence's life by several years. For instance, replacing rotted posts with pressure-treated lumber in combination with proper drainage solutions can add substantial durability, especially in areas prone to moisture.
